blocking: Track-line draw length is wrong: the .track-line paths use vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke, so stroke-dasharray/offset set from getTotalLength() (1000 or 1200 user units) are applied in SCREEN pixels, not scaled to the rendered line. The phone journey (phone-3 shot) shows the gold line already past the Proposal dot while that dot is still sage; on how-we-work.html the vertical steps track is far taller than 1000px, so the overlay shows a 1000px gold run, a 1000px sage gap, then gold again, and never reads as one drawn line.

fixes.where: assets/js/site.js block 5 (and block 4 kashida) — `var len = p.getTotalLength()`
fixes.what: Measure the rendered length instead: `var r = p.getBoundingClientRect(); var len = Math.max(r.width, r.height);` and pass dash values as functions (`fromTo(p,{strokeDashoffset:function(){return len()}},{strokeDashoffset:0})`) with `invalidateOnRefresh:true` on the timeline's scrollTrigger; or drop dashes entirely and scrub `scaleX/scaleY` (transformOrigin '0 50%' / '50% 0') on the overlay svg.
fixes.why: Under non-scaling-stroke the dash pattern is in device pixels, so a viewBox-based length breaks on any track taller/wider than the viewBox.

fixes.what: Compute each dot's position from layout, not an even split: vertical `at = (d.offsetTop + 7) / track.offsetHeight`, horizontal `at = (d.getBoundingClientRect().left - track.getBoundingClientRect().left + 7) / track.offsetWidth`; recompute inside a function used by the timeline (rebuild on ScrollTrigger 'refreshInit').
fixes.why: Journey stops have different heights on phones and the steps on How we work are very uneven, so the dots turn gold at the wrong moment relative to the line.

fixes.where: index.html / weddings.html / how-we-work.html / about.html <head> — the three defer <script> tags
fixes.what: Self-host gsap.min.js, ScrollTrigger.min.js and lenis.min.js under assets/js/vendor/ (≈125 KB total) and drop the cdnjs/unpkg preconnects; if the CDN must stay, add `integrity="sha384-…"` hashes to all three tags.
fixes.why: Pinned-but-unhashed third-party scripts can be swapped upstream; two extra origins also sit on the critical path for motion.

fixes.where: index.html (all pages) `<button class="motion-toggle" aria-label="Motion" aria-pressed="false">` + site.js setToggle()
fixes.what: Rename the fixed accessible name to `aria-label="Pause motion"` and keep aria-pressed="true" meaning paused; leave the visible text as is.
fixes.why: "Motion, pressed" is announced as motion ON while the site is actually paused: a toggle's name must describe the pressed state.

fixes.what: Self-host the Arabic-subset woff2 of Noto Naskh Arabic (400 + 700) under assets/fonts/, declare it with @font-face font-display:swap in site.css and preload the 400 file like TTRamillas-Bold.
fixes.why: The Google Fonts CSS is a render-blocking cross-origin request on every page; the hero tag and nav فارسی flash in Tahoma on first paint.

fixes.what: Keep the 44px only where text can collide with the tab (`.accordion__body`, `.quote blockquote`, `.journey__stop`) and give centred blocks matching left padding: `.section__head,.statement,.journey__order,.journey__extras,.teaser__foot{padding-left:24px}`.
fixes.why: At 390px every centred heading, kashida and pill row sits 12px left of centre (visible in phone-1 and phone-3), reading as a layout mistake.
